prompt: A retro 1980s-style cartoon illustration inspired by Steven Harrington, featuring a playful character running forward with exaggerated motion. The character has bold outlines, a simplified yet expressive face with a wild, crazy, looney expression--wide eyes, a huge grin, and an over-the-top energetic vibe. Dressed in vintage athletic wear, including a t-shirt, shorts, and classic sneakers with a distinctive sole, the design is minimalistic, using a limited color palette with high contrast and clean shapes. The background is white with subtle abstract elements to enhance the sense of motion without overwhelming the composition. The illustration should feel fun, urban, and surreal, capturing the bold and graphic aesthetic reminiscent of 1980s streetwear culture and Steven Harrington’s signature style. --ar 1:1 --v 6.1
